title: Troubleshoot a Haas mill spindle before replacing it

context.subsystem: mill spindle (lubrication, heat, noise/vibration, tool sticking)

machine_family.note: The official description speaks of 'your mill spindle'.

subsystem.note: Named in the title and narration.

symptoms.note: The four symptoms are stated in the narration and shown as on-screen headings.

steps.title: Seized spindle: check lubrication and the pump
Spindle running hot: check the amount of oil
Noise or vibration: rule out tooling, balance, alignment and belts
Stuck tool: check tooling, application and spindle temperature
Correct orientation damage before replacing the spindle

questions.question: How do you confirm the root cause is found before deciding to replace the spindle?
How is the pump rebuild or oil change confirmed as having fixed the lubrication?
What oil amount or delivery rate is correct? The video defers to the pump documentation.
What balance or vibration reading counts as acceptable?
Does the alignment check apply only to inline spindles, or to every spindle with a separate motor?
How is the orientation problem diagnosed and corrected? The video only says it must be corrected.
